text: This one link ends order chaos for food businesses. Watch.
Orders by voice note. Two burgers, no onions. Wait, was that one order or two? Mixed-up orders, and hungry customers waiting.
Instead, customers open your menu, tap what they want, and add a note, like no onions.
The order arrives neat and clear, with the total already worked out.
Run out of something? Hide it in one tap, so nobody orders it.
